payload.title: Forum index: <threadBase>/ lists public threads one line each, paged, with a forum layout for the threads include
payload.description:
Repo: **Papyrus**. Phase 2 of PPY-452419: the forum front, `<threadBase>/` (default `/conversations/`), one line per thread, old-web-forum style.

## Files
- `src/papyrus_content/projection/standard/forum_pages.py` (from the thread-pages task): `forum_index_pages(context)`: reads `_data/home-page/threads.json` (`{generatedAt, threads:[{key,title,anchor,messages:<count>,lastAt,latest:<message>}]}`), sorts by `lastAt` descending, pages by `homePage.forum.index.pageSize` (default 50; a page size is a layout choice, not a cap), paths `<threadBase>/`, `<threadBase>/page/2/` following the listing pager (`projector.py` listing pages; reuse `pageSuffix`).
- Row layout (`assets/papyrus-home-page.css`, class prefix `papyrus-forum-`): Lucide `message-square` icon; title linking to the thread page; the anchor as a second line ("about: <Reference title>" with `link` icon, or "story: <title>" with `newspaper` icon); reply count as "12 messages" text; last activity `<time>` with the latest author's handle or label. Flat rows separated by background alternation (`:nth-child(even)` tone), no hairlines. Never colour alone: an unanswered thread (1 message) gets a `circle-dashed` icon and the text "no replies yet".
- A `::include{kind="threads" layout="forum"}` variant renders the same rows on an authored page (so a site can put the forum under its own hero), sharing the row renderer.
- `.md` twin: a Markdown table (title, about, messages, last activity) through `add()`.
- Nav: `homePage.forum.navLabel` (optional, default none) adds the forum to the standard nav the way sections do (`urls.sections.<name>.label`); read how #908 added section fronts to the nav.

## Gherkin (`features_backend/forum-index.feature`)
Feature: The forum index lists public threads
  Scenario: Threads are listed newest activity first with their message counts
  Scenario: The index pages at the configured page size
  Scenario: A thread with one message is marked "no replies yet" with an icon, not colour
  Scenario: The forum layout of the threads include renders the same rows on an authored page
  Scenario: The index has a Markdown twin

## Acceptance
- Fixture renders `conversations/index.html`, `conversations/page/2/index.html` (with page size 1 in the fixture) and the twins; reader-privacy scan clean; `docs/home-page.md` "Forum index" section.
- Blocked by the thread-pages task (shared module and settings).
